build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run notices && npm run check:release

security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: https://m.media-amazon.com https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com; media-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.longDescription: An unofficial Windows companion with a local library, notes and a compact always-on-top player. Not affiliated with Audible or Amazon.
